name: Web Applications
heroSubtitle: Powerful web-based applications designed to simplify operations, improve productivity and solve real business challenges.
shortDescription: We build custom web applications that help businesses and organisations manage tasks, streamline processes and deliver digital services.
fullDescription: TOP TECH develops custom web applications designed around the specific needs of businesses, organisations and entrepreneurs. From management dashboards and booking platforms to customer portals and business tools, we turn ideas into practical browser-based applications. We focus on usability, responsive interfaces, reliable functionality and scalable foundations to help clients work more efficiently and serve their users better.

benefits.title: Tailored to Your Exact Workflow
benefits.description: Eliminate manual copy-pasting between disconnected spreadsheets with software built around how your team works.

benefits.title: Accessible From Any Browser
benefits.description: Zero desktop installation overhead—authorized staff or clients sign in securely from any device.

benefits.title: Maintainable TypeScript Codebase
benefits.description: Clean modular architecture makes future feature additions and integrations predictable and cost-effective.

features.title: Structured Data Tables & Filters
features.description: Sortable, searchable records with tabular numeric alignment and instant CSV or report exports.

features.title: Role-Based Views
features.description: Separate administrator, staff, and client permissions so every user sees only what they need.

features.title: Interactive Analytics & Summaries
features.description: Clear visual indicators and real-time KPI summaries without visual clutter.

features.title: API & Webhook Connectivity
features.description: Connect payment processors, CRM systems, email providers, or external databases seamlessly.

processSteps.title: Workflow & Data Modeling
processSteps.description: We document user roles, database entities, permissions, and core operational tasks.

processSteps.title: Interactive UI Architecture
processSteps.description: We design clean dashboard screens, forms, and navigation flows optimized for daily speed.

processSteps.title: Full-Stack Engineering
processSteps.description: We implement the frontend, API routes, validation, authentication, and database persistence.

processSteps.title: Testing & Team Onboarding
processSteps.description: We run end-to-end validation checks and guide your administrators through live deployment.

faqs.question: Can a custom web app replace our spreadsheets?
faqs.answer: Yes. We routinely turn multi-tab spreadsheets into structured web applications with validation, search, user roles, and automated reporting.

faqs.question: Can it integrate with tools we already use?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build clean integrations for email services, payment APIs, cloud storage, and third-party business tools.

faqs.question: Will the web app work on tablets and phones too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every web application is engineered responsively so managers and staff can check updates from mobile browsers.

idealFor: Growing teams, service businesses, and startups replacing manual workflows with custom software.
